definitions.explanation: The hair that grows on the brow ridge above the eye.

examples.japanese: {眉毛|まゆげ}を{整|ととの}える。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{眉毛|まゆげ}の{形|かたち}がきれいだ。
{眉毛|まゆげ}を{剃|そ}りすぎて{変|へん}な{顔|かお}になった。
examples.english: I shaved my eyebrows too much and ended up with a funny-looking face.

notes:
{眉毛|まゆげ} refers to the hair on the brow ridge above the eye.

WORD FORMATION:
{眉|まゆ} (brow) + {毛|げ} (hair). {眉|まゆ} alone can also mean eyebrow.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {眉毛|まゆげ}を{整|ととの}える: to groom eyebrows
- {眉毛|まゆげ}を{描|か}く: to draw on eyebrows (makeup)
- {眉毛|まゆげ}を{剃|そ}る: to shave eyebrows
- {眉毛|まゆげ}を{抜|ぬ}く: to pluck eyebrows
- {眉毛|まゆげ}が{濃|こ}い/{薄|うす}い: thick/thin eyebrows

IDIOMS:
- {眉|まゆ}をひそめる: to frown, to show displeasure
- {眉|まゆ}{唾|つば}: dubious, suspicious (lit. "brow spit")

RELATED:
- {眉間|みけん}: the space between the eyebrows
